capabilities: Syncs #pecklist-tagged task lines both ways with a PeckList server
Maps Tasks-plugin fields (dates, priority, tags, repeats, done) to PeckList
Reviews tagged lines and excludes folders, notes or single lines before syncing
Lists all tasks in a task manager with filters, search and bulk actions
Adds a bird icon menu, tag suggestions and hidden ids on synced lines
extras: Full settings guide is at pecklist.com/obsidian. README stresses privacy: only tagged lines leave the device, no telemetry, API key stays in Obsidian's secret storage, and the plugin never sees your password.
intentEvidence: Needs the community Tasks plugin and a PeckList server (0.10 or later).
problem: Task lines written in Obsidian stay on the device, with no way to keep them in step with a self-hosted task server or edit them from a phone.

relations.evidence: Write a task in the Tasks plugin's format, tag it #pecklist, and it shows up in PeckList.
Sync task lines in your notes with your own PeckList server, both ways.

summary: Two-way sync that links Tasks-plugin lines tagged #pecklist to your own PeckList server, carrying titles, dates, priority, tags, repeats and done state.
